column3: “They were” is rendered “came into being,” and “afflicted” as “humble.”
NASB adds “is like” throughout, making each pair a comparison.
NASB renders the question “and not cause to bring forth” as “and not give delivery,” and “restrain” as “shut the womb.”
“Peace” is rendered “peace,” and “abundance of nations” as “the glory of the nations.”
“After one in the middle” is rendered “Following one in the center”; the meaning is uncertain.
NASB has “Put” for “Pul,” and “Meshech, Rosh” for “those who draw the bow,” following a different reading.
